name: Support chat — replacement went to a closed office

turns.speaker: lena
turns.text: The replacement went to Lyon, but we moved out early: the Lyon office closed on October 2 and nobody was there to sign. From now on ship only to Grenoble: Brightmoor Labs, 9 Rue Felix Viallet, 38000 Grenoble.

turns.speaker: quill
turns.text: I am sorry. I have re-shipped the replacement to 9 Rue Felix Viallet, 38000 Grenoble, and the Lyon address will not be used again.
